channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strike kills 3 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy faces pressure at home
item.description: At least 14 of the 20 people wounded in the strike on Kyiv have been hospitalised, officials say.

item.title: Alarm in South Korea as Iran dispute with Trump shakes a 72-year alliance
item.description: Trump's order to scale back military drills rattles Seoul, reviving doubts over US security guarantees.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump announces ‘most crushing’ Iran sanctions
item.description: Trump says Washington may resume talks with Tehran 'at some point'.

item.title: ‘We do not trust Israeli judiciary’ says Hind Rajab’s grandmother
item.description: The grandmother of Hind Rajab, a five-year-old Palestinian girl killed in her family’s car by Israeli forces in Gaza.

item.title: Trump announces ‘most crushing economic operation ever’ against Iran
item.description: US president announces 'economic operation' against Iran, promises measures against nations trading with Tehran.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza City police headquarters kills women’s police chief
item.description: An Israeli strike on Gaza City’s police headquarters has killed the women’s police chief and several officers.

item.title: USS Lincoln woes highlight US Navy limits in prolonged Iran war: Experts
item.description: Reports of dire conditions underscore supply challenges, questions of US plans going forward, experts say.

item.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
item.description: The five-year-old Palestinian girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

item.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
item.description: Australia's foreign minister summoned the Israeli ambassador over 'insulting' Zomi Frankcom decision.

item.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous economic consequences' on any country helping Iran
item.description: It comes after a 60-day ceasefire expired on Monday, with no sign of a diplomatic or military off-ramp to the conflict.
